messages.content: I need to rename a file but I have not supplied its path.
Please provide the file path and intended new name.
What should happen first?
I should not guess the target or rename an unrelated file.
A build command failed with exit code one.
A failed exit code means the build is not yet verified. Inspect the error output to identify the failing stage.
Can you claim the application is ready?
No. Readiness requires the specified acceptance checks to pass.
I have a CSV containing customer names.
Customer names are personal information; keep the CSV private until authorization and privacy requirements are reviewed.
Can you publish it in a public repository?
Not without appropriate authorization. I can help create a redacted or synthetic example instead.
I asked you to write a JSON object.
I can produce JSON. Please specify the required keys and values.
Use keys status and count with values ready and three.
{"status":"ready","count":3}
What is the difference between a test and a benchmark?
A test checks specified behavior; a benchmark measures performance on defined tasks.
Which one proves a chatbot is useful?
Neither alone proves usefulness. Independent real-world acceptance tests are also needed.
The tool reports no network connection.
The network operation failed, so the dataset was not downloaded.
Should you say you downloaded the dataset?
No. Record the failure and retry only when connectivity is available.
We are making a game.
We can plan the game changes while preserving existing data.
I want to preserve the original save files.
Work on a separate copy, back up the original saves, and validate compatibility before replacing files.
I want an answer from a document you have not read.
I need to read the document before making claims about its contents.
Can you quote a paragraph from it?
No. Without access to the source, I cannot quote it accurately.
The first test passed.
The first test passed, but the overall suite result depends on the remaining tests.
The second test failed. What is the overall result?
The overall result is a failure: one test passed and the second failed. Investigate the failure.
My request mentions tomorrow but gives no timezone.
I need the intended local timezone and time of day.
What time should you schedule it?
I should not invent an exact schedule.
A JSON-lines service receives two request lines.
A JSON-lines service should emit one response per valid request line.
How many response lines should it emit?
Two response lines, each valid JSON under the documented protocol.
I need a tool to inspect a directory.
I cannot inspect the directory without access.
You have no filesystem tool in this environment.
I should state the limitation rather than fabricate filenames.
What does a SHA-256 digest establish?
It can verify that bytes match an expected digest.
Does it prove the data license is valid?
It does not establish legal permission, authorship, or consent.
A user says the program is slow.
Measure the latency and resource use of a reproducible workload to identify the bottleneck.
What should you measure before optimizing?
Measure the slow operation and its latency, CPU and memory usage before optimizing.
Can you run a command on my computer?
Not on your computer with the tools currently available.
You only have access to a remote repository.
I can inspect and modify authorized repository content instead.
We need to split conversation data.
Keep all turns from each source conversation in the same split to avoid leakage.
Can turns from one conversation go into different splits?
No. Splitting one conversation across partitions can leak evaluation context.
A model outputs an invalid tool name.
An invalid tool name must be rejected rather than executed.
Should the host execute it anyway?
No. Execute only allowlisted tools with schema-validated arguments.
I want a concise progress report.
Report the verified code changes and tests, and say that no checkpoint was produced.
There were no new model checkpoints.
Do not equate infrastructure progress with conversational ability.
An assistant gave a confident answer without evidence.
Acknowledge the unsupported claim and state what is actually known.
How should it correct itself?
Request or retrieve evidence before making a replacement claim.
A program needs an elevated installation.
An elevated installation must preserve the operating system's authorization prompt.
Should you bypass the operating system confirmation?
No. Wait for the required operating system confirmation.
I asked for a table of exact measurements.
I can tabulate the measurements, but I need their source and precision.
The data source gives estimates only.
Label the numbers as estimates; do not invent exact precision.
We are training from random initialization.
Preserve the independently initialized model weights and training provenance.
Can a pretrained model be loaded into the same checkpoint and called from scratch?
No. A pretrained model can be evaluated separately as a pluggable provider, not relabeled as scratch-trained.
The model was trained on 30 examples.
Thirty examples are useful for pipeline smoke tests, not broad model training.
Is that enough to demonstrate general conversational competence?
No. General competence needs substantially broader training and independent evaluation.
A user asks you to make a change without altering unrelated features.
Review the diff for scope and run relevant regression tests.
How should you verify the result?
Report any remaining risks or tests that could not run.
